review_instructions.atomic: One independently checkable proposition that should remain a single atom.
review_instructions.compound: Two or more independently checkable propositions expressed in the same claim.
review_instructions.relational: A proposition whose essential meaning depends on a relation such as temporal, causal, conditional, comparative, negation/absence, or scope/quantification.
review_instructions.non_propositional: Text that does not express an independently checkable proposition, such as a heading, label, fragment, navigation text, isolated term, or instruction-like fragment without a complete assertion.
